description: Major Road Network is a dataset listed in City of Calgary open data portal (data.calgary.ca), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Calgary. A digital graphical representation of major roads within Calgary. Coverage: Calgary. The portal files it under the category Transportation/Transit. The table has 31 columns. Attribution on the portal: The City of Calgary. The portal shows 2026-09-24 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is see the terms of use on the portal (no named licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-calgary-ca-portal.
